method:
Original concrete core-bitrate backend -> quality/filter -> storage fields.

The real backend vtable and its property readers execute unchanged, followed by
original quality, rank, format gate and storage owners. Synthetic typed feature
provider results are injected at the configuration interface, not at backend
methods. Product/preferences and standard primitives retain the existing oracle
bindings. No proprietary backend setting, format flag or request choice is
substituted. Execution stops before dispatch; no profile, account or network.
limitations: Typed feature-service values are synthetic provider results; feature acquisition/parsing is separate.
No Free/Premium name-to-entitlement inference, native transport or live account acceptance.
WiFi secondary setting is captured but backend-advised selection remains separate.
